sloka: यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति ।पूर्वम् चापरकर्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ ॥६-१२-३२॥।।
transliteration: yaḥ paścātpūrvakāryāṇi karmāṇyabhicikīrṣati ।pūrvam cāparakaryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau ॥6-12-32॥।।

translations.english: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."
